title: Hard or Mislabeled? Failure Screens Enrich Vision Benchmarks for Label Errors
abstract: arXiv:2611.19044v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hard vision benchmarks often keep images that strong classifiers get wrong. Since a classifier is also marked wrong when the label is wrong, such failure screens may collect label errors. We measure this on ImageNet's twice-relabeled validation set with 103 classifiers. Among the 1,892 images that all 66 supervised classifiers get wrong, 61% have a wrong label, versus 11.1% overall. The fewer images a screen lets through, the more of them are mislabeled, along approximately one curve. Fit on one model family, this curve predicts the screens of two held-out model families with a mean error of 2.4 percentage points, and replays of ImageNet-D's and ImageNet-Hard's screens within 0.1 and 6.3 points. On new pools, ImageNet-V2 and CIFAR-10, enrichment at the strictest screens is stronger than the curve predicts: on ImageNet-V2, by human relabeling, 67% of the images that all 66 classifiers get wrong are mislabeled, against 46% predicted. translated_title: 难样本还是错标签？失败筛选为视觉基准富集标签错误
translated_abstract: 难例视觉基准通常保留强分类器判错的图像。由于标签本身错误时分类器也会被记为出错，这类失败筛选可能收集到标签错误。我们在ImageNet经过两次重新标注的验证集上，使用103个分类器对这一现象进行了测量。在66个监督分类器全部判错的1,892张图像中，61%存在错误标签，而整体错误标签率仅为11.1%。筛选放行的图像越少，其中被错标的比例越高，且大致沿同一条曲线变化。该曲线在单一模型家族上拟合后，能以平均2.4个百分点的误差预测两个留出模型家族的筛选结果，并对ImageNet-D与ImageNet-Hard筛选的重放误差分别控制在0.1和6.3个百分点之内。在新的图像池ImageNet-V2与CIFAR-10上，最严格筛选处的富集程度甚至强于曲线预测：在ImageNet-V2上，经人工重新标注，66个分类器全部判错的图像中有67%被错标，而曲线预测仅为46%。
tldr: 该研究揭示视觉基准中的失败筛选（所有强分类器均判错的图像）高度富集标签错误——ImageNet上此类图像61%被错标而整体仅11.1%，且富集程度大致沿一条可跨模型家族迁移预测的曲线变化，在最严格的筛选处富集效应更强。
en_tdlr: Failure screens—images that all strong classifiers get wrong—are strongly enriched for label errors (61% mislabeled on ImageNet vs 11.1% overall), with enrichment following a single curve that transfers across model families and grows even stronger at the strictest screens.
